title: Tour of a sci-fi helmet

content.html:
Visor

The transparent front surface protects the wearer's eyes from debris and UV radiation. The damage shown here is from micrometeoroid impact.

Outer shell

A composite of carbon-fibre plating over a Kevlar weave. Designed to absorb and redistribute kinetic energy from impacts.

Air intake

Filters and cools incoming air before it reaches the breathing apparatus. Replaceable particulate filters slot in beneath the grille.
